verdict.rationale: Superhuman Mail documents an official MCP server that connects the inbox to Claude and ChatGPT, but nothing in the evidence shows issuing scoped or least-privilege API credentials or tokens for an agent. Org-level connector permissions and per-send approval are related controls, not scoped credential issuance. The probes found no public OpenAPI spec.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can issue scoped/least-privilege API credentials for an agent
